description: Update an existing bot auto-reply rule by ID. Only the provided fields change; everything else stays as it was. "channels" limits the rule to some channels ([] = every channel). Run get_bot_conversations first to find the conversation ID.

agent_id.description: Moderator ID to auto-assign to the contact when triggered (use 0 to clear)

ask_contact.description: Optional. Make the rule ask the customer for their phone number ("phone") or e-mail ("email") with one tap. On Facebook Messenger the reply text goes out with a quick-reply button pre-filled from the customer's Facebook profile (hidden by Meta when the profile has no such value); the tapped value is saved on the contact (e-mail field when empty, otherwise an internal note; phone always as an internal note). Instagram has no equivalent (Meta disabled it), so Instagram, WhatsApp and other channels receive the text only and the customer types the answer; a typed phone number / e-mail (within 24 hours of the ask) is saved the same way. "text" is optional with this argument: empty = a standard question. "none" turns an ask rule back into a plain text reply. The rule must reply on Messenger (channels [] or including "messenger").

channels.description: Optional. Channels this rule replies on, e.g. ["instagram", "messenger"]. Omit or [] = every channel (default). "whatsapp" covers both official and unofficial WhatsApp numbers. On other channels the message falls through to the other rules, the default reply or the AI.

confirmation.description: Optional, with an "ask_contact" rule only. Confirmation message sent ONCE on the same channel and in the same conversation right after the customer taps the Messenger button and shares the phone number / e-mail, or — on any channel — types one in their next messages within 24 hours of the ask, e.g. "Thanks, we'll contact you by WhatsApp". While it is set, neither keyword rules nor the AI answer that message. Max 2000 characters. Pass "" to remove it.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this auto-reply rule

hear.description: New trigger keyword or phrase that activates this reply

id.description: ID of the bot conversation to update

label_id.description: Label ID to auto-assign to the contact when triggered (use 0 to clear)

match_message.description: If true, requires an exact match. If false, partial/fuzzy match.

text.description: New reply message text to send when triggered

name: update_bot_conversation
